comment: I opened my account last week and the ID verification took three tries. The photo kept getting rejected and it never told me why.
Face login is great. Opens in a second, I love it.
Face login fails every other time and then asks for my password anyway. Pointless.
Sending money to a friend takes too many steps. I just want to tap their name and type an amount.
I can never find my monthly statements. I looked under Accounts, then Documents, then Settings. Finally Google told me.
App is bad.
Notifications are useful for card transactions but I get way too many promo ones. I turned everything off and now I miss the important ones.
The text is too small and the grey on white is hard to read. I need my grandson to help me pay bills.
Where is the dark mode? Every other app I use has it.
Transaction search only lets me search by date. I need to search by merchant or amount to reconcile my invoices.
Love the new look, so clean and modern. Everything is easy to find.
The redesign hid everything I used daily. Where did bill payments go? Had to call the bank.
I was not sure if my transfer went through. The screen just closed with no confirmation and I almost sent it twice.
Too many OTP codes. I get one for login, one for adding a payee, and another for the transfer itself. Feels like overkill.
I actually like the extra security steps. It makes me feel my money is safe, especially for large transfers.
Crashes whenever I open it on my old phone. Please fix.
I pressed the wrong button and sent money to the wrong person. There was no way to cancel or undo it.
I would love to export my transactions to Excel or PDF. Right now I take screenshots, which is ridiculous.
Would be nice to see spending broken down by category, like food, transport, and bills.
The app asked me to set up a savings goal during signup, but I had no idea what it was for. I skipped it and could not find it again later.
The branch near my house always has a long queue and the staff were rude to me yesterday.
Loading is slow in the evening. The balance sometimes takes 10 seconds to show up.
I could not find how to contact support inside the app. The chat button is hidden at the very bottom of the profile page.
Please add an Urdu language option. English banking words confuse my parents.
I manage two accounts and switching between them is confusing. I sometimes pay from the wrong one.
Great app, 5 stars.
The ATM near my office keeps running out of cash on Fridays.
I wish I could give my teenager a limited card and control it from my app. Right now I have to share my own login details, which I do not feel good about.
Error code 4012 appeared when I tried to pay my electricity bill. No explanation, no next step.
Quick actions on the home screen are handy, but I cannot change which ones show up. I never use half of them.
